youtubeUrl.title: YouTube URL
youtubeUrl.description: Full YouTube URL or short link (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID or https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID)

openRouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API Key
openRouterApiKey.description: Your OpenRouter API key for Whisper transcription fallback. Only needed if video has no available captions. Get it from https://openrouter.ai/keys

openRouterModel.title: OpenRouter Model
openRouterModel.description: Whisper model for audio transcription. Defaults to openai/whisper-large-v3 (best quality but slower)
